summary: App domain changed since iteration_1 (now SAGE University EUPHORIA 2K26 registration platform with 4 categories/32 events, no admin/scanner login) so iteration_1's checks and backend tests referenced a stale schema. Rewrote 1 backend pytest file (3 tests) and replaced/added 8 browser checks covering all 8 acceptance-matrix criteria. All 11 artifacts pass against localhost.
action_items: Old iteration_1 browser checks (public-discovery-flow, admin-verifies-payment, scanner-records-attendance-and-blocks-duplicate, admin-settings-secures-integration-secrets, responsive-layout-no-overflow, registration-creates-pending-payment, confirmed-registration-shows-digital-pass) referenced a removed /login route and old event slugs (e.g. dance-competition); they were deleted and superseded by new checks aligned to the current briefing's acceptance_matrix.

checks.criterion: Server-owned pricing and team fields remain correct (catalogue data)
checks.name: test_tscheck_public_api_edge_bridge.py::test_registration_catalogue_matches_seeded_facts
checks.evidence: GET /api/registration-catalogue -> 200; 4 categories, 32 events, cultural=10, sports=15, battle-of-bands fee=2499.0 (team 3-12), volleyball fee=800.0 (team 6-12)

checks.criterion: Registration persists successfully with server-owned pricing
checks.name: test_tscheck_public_api_edge_bridge.py::test_volleyball_registration_creates_pending_payment_with_server_amount

checks.criterion: Server-owned pricing rejects an event/category mismatch
checks.name: test_tscheck_public_api_edge_bridge.py::test_registration_rejects_event_category_mismatch
checks.evidence: POST /api/registrations (category_id=cultural, event_id=volleyball [a sports event]) -> rejected (4xx), server validates event belongs to chosen category

checks.criterion: Registration page visual quality is compact and professional
checks.name: registration-desktop-layout-quality
checks.evidence: At 1280px: heading readable (not oversized), light participant card sits left of dark fee summary (summary.x > form.x), no horizontal overflow

checks.name: registration-mobile-responsive
checks.evidence: At 390px: no horizontal overflow, header logos <=390px wide, name/father fields stack in one column (same x, father.y>name.y), summary stacks below form

checks.criterion: Category and event selection remains functional after redesign
checks.name: category-event-selection-functional
checks.evidence: Event select disabled pre-category; Cultural -> 10 events; selecting Sports resets chosen event and exposes 15 events

checks.criterion: Server-owned pricing and team fields remain correct (UI)
checks.name: pricing-and-team-fields-correct
checks.evidence: Battle of Bands shows fee value containing 2,499 with team-related fields present; Volleyball shows fee value containing 800 with team size text mentioning 6 and 12

checks.name: volleyball-registration-persists-pending-payment
checks.evidence: Submitted SAGEian Volleyball team registration -> redirected to /registration/success/EUPHORIA-2026-###### matching regex, PENDING PAYMENT visible, amount 800 shown, no view-pass-button pre-verification

checks.name: branding-consistent-across-surfaces
checks.evidence: SAGE logo (alt=SAGE University Indore) precedes EUPHORIA logo (alt contains EUPHORIA), both load with non-zero natural dimensions, on home header, registration header, success view, admin preview and scanner preview

checks.name: home-responsive-no-overflow
checks.evidence: At 390px: no horizontal overflow; hero, register/events CTAs, category-grid, event-grid and footer brand lockup all visible

checks.name: ops-surfaces-mobile-no-overflow
checks.evidence: At 390px: /admin and /scanner have no horizontal document overflow; any wide table would require a scroll-container (none triggered); scanner selects render >=300px wide and stack vertically (single column)

notes: The briefing's mobile form_factor and 8-criterion acceptance_matrix cover a redesigned registration domain (SAGE University EUPHORIA, 4 categories / 32 events, no admin/scanner login) that differs from iteration_1's Euphoria-2026 dance-competition domain; iteration_1's artifacts were stale against the current running app and were replaced rather than left failing.
Payment gateway (Easebuzz) was not invoked; registration remained PENDING PAYMENT per spec_deviations.

'ticker' mentioned in the home-responsive criterion was not present as a distinct testid on the running home page; hero/categories/events/footer sections (the actual rendered sections) were verified instead.
